# Sample (`sample` v1)

A sequenced specimen: tissue, diagnosis, variants called with allele fraction and depth, and QC.

**Group:** Genomics and biology · **Mnemonic:** `SMPL` · **Identifiers:** `SMPL-…` in `sampleId`

Open one with `SMPL <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: sample
version: 1
description: "A sequenced specimen: tissue, diagnosis, variants called with allele fraction and depth, and QC."
match: { kind: sample, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Genomics and biology · Sample, id: $.sampleId }
strip:
  - { label: Tissue, bind: $.tissue }
  - { label: Diagnosis, bind: $.diagnosis }
  - { label: Tumour purity, bind: $.purity, fmt: pct0 }
  - { label: Variants called, bind: $.variantCount, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Mean coverage, bind: $.meanCoverage, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Collected, bind: $.collected, fmt: date }
panels:
  - id: calls
    kind: table
    title: Variant calls
    key: F2
    rows: $.calls
    columns:
      - { label: Variant, bind: "@.variant" }
      - { label: Gene, bind: "@.gene" }
      - { label: VAF, bind: "@.vaf", fmt: pct2, total: true }
      - { label: Depth, bind: "@.depth", fmt: amount0 }
      - { label: Filter, bind: "@.filter", tone: status }
  - id: qc
    kind: kv
    title: Quality control
    key: F3
    area: right
    rows: $.qc
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.sequencingRun, 'sequencing-run')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

| Collected | `$.collected` | `date` |
